evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI acknowledged an indirect YC fund interest originating before Altman worked full-time at OpenAI. This disclosure postdates the hearing and does not itself establish the precise holdings or intended meaning of his answer on May 16.

Supports the existence of a control arrangement involving Altman at the fund's inception. This is reporting used because the attempted primary filing was inaccessible; control does not establish personal profit entitlement.

Material counterevidence to treating legal ownership as proof of a personal economic stake. It is an attributed company assertion reported later, not independent verification of Altman's rights on the hearing date.
